text.text_excerpt: Definitely worth the hype!!! Places like this make me really love my neighborhood. Cheap, tasty and very filling, what more do you need for $10? Sure it's not the healthiest stuff in the world, but healthy isn't what you're craving when you're looking for a decent bbq rib or shrimp po boy. And this place delivers on both. I went there on a quiet Sat afternoon when I wanted to picnic at the park. So I called them and less than 5 mins. later, I got a big 10' shrimp po boy. Had decent-sized shrimp (25-30 count) that was super fresh! Best of all, the shrimp had the yummy fried shrimp batter you normally get in a seafood or shrimp platter instead of the softer batter most places use for their ...

This place is the definition of cheap, not-so-good-for you but-oh-so-delicious, comfort food. I got a small portion of the shrimp pasta and a small gumbo, for $11.42 and this was enough for two people to split! The shrimp are succulent and still have that seafood-y taste which I like (and to me means that they haven't been overcooked). The gumbo had plenty of meat in it and with a few drops of hot sauce is divine! I wanted to sample everything on their hot line but because I am aware that my eyes are bigger than my stomach, I only got those two items. I have heard the shrimp fried rice is amazing and it definitely appeared to be. I'll probably try this next time I go. They seem to have a ...

If there was a choice between the spot on Broad and St Bernard and Orchid, as far as the gumbo is concerned...Orchid wins. They have the perfect balance of chicken and seafood with that real hearty and rich roux. Not to mention, I used to praise the shrimp po boys at the gas station spot next door to this place (corner of Broad and Esplanade), but Orchid came through for the win with the po boys too. The staff that works here are always engaging, which is a bit different , but cool for a spot like this. That aligned with their propensity for good weekend food is a plus.
